item.title: 🟠 Possible new Cellebrite iPhone Radio Zero-Day
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — review monitoring and incident-response readiness.

Justin.sh is reporting on a confidential Cellebrite document that has been leaked to him:

Cellebrite calls it Advanced Unlocks (AU from here on), not to be confused with the “advanced unlocking services” they’ve marketed for years. A press release from earlier this year confirms AU is a new product for 2026.

[…]

According to Cellebrite, AU:

  • is a “next-generation AFU vector that is more resilient to Apple’s OS changes”
  • works with Stolen Device Protection enabled, which tightens USB restrictions
  • is enabled by a dedicated appliance with a stated range (!) of about 8 meters...


Source: Schneier on Security  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1d
